Hello, and welcome to Cordone! Check out our official guide to getting settled in our region to make the most of your time here :)
https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=2608883

[quote=socialist_states_of_communistan;58532129]Hello, I am new to this region & this whole nation states game.  How should I best get settled & join the role play & get a spot on the map & whatnot?  Also, is English the preferred language for the region?[/quote]

Nationstates is a website made by a dude named Max Barry. It's basically a site to make an entire nation, use it via roleplay, and- we'll, you basically run a nation.

There are a bunch of buttons at the top of your screen, but there are really 2 you need to worry about. The lightning icon, which is just your notifications, and the stickman, which are called issues. Issues are basically things that happen, and you're supposed to decide what happens. There is also an envelope, which is called the telegram, and is kind of like direct messaging. 

Right now you're in the chat area, which is called the "rmb" or regional messaging board. Here you can just chat with people. Simple.

Talk to me about anything else. As I found it pretty confusing when I joined too.
Thank you
[nation]shahzada[/nation] tart
